name: singlet_enrichment_differential_pathway_activity
title: Differential pathway activity between conditions (donor-level)
description: Tests whether pathway, TF-regulon or program activity differs between conditions within each annotated cell type, with donors or samples as the replicates. The default takes donor-aware gene-level contrast statistics, scores each pathway with a signed univariate linear model, and calibrates p-values by donor-label permutation. Requires raw counts, donor, cell-type and condition labels and a gene-set or signed footprint resource in uns. Writes uns/pathway_de per method and cell type. Do not use it to test per-cell scores against cells, for cell-type abundance, or when donors per group are below the minimum.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Pathway inference route. Keep the default; the other values are comparators with documented outputs.

design.description: Donor, cell-type, condition and covariate keys, and the replicate unit.

donor_key.description: obs column naming the donor or biological sample.

cell_type_key.description: obs column of cell-type labels; each type is tested separately.

condition_key.description: obs column of condition labels with two or more levels.

unit.description: Replicate unit; cell-level units are rejected for condition tests.

covariates.description: obs columns added to the design, such as batch, sex, age or depth.

pseudobulk.description: Donor-by-cell-type aggregation and filtering before testing.

aggregation.description: Cell aggregation; mean is available as a sensitivity check.

min_cells.description: Minimum cells in a donor-by-cell-type pseudobulk.

min_counts.description: Minimum total counts per pseudobulk sample.

min_donors_per_group.description: Minimum donors per condition level before a cell type is tested.

pathway_set.description: Pathway resource and set-size limits, required by every method.

resource.description: uns key of a long table with source, target and weight columns.

min_size.description: Minimum set size after intersection with tested genes.

max_size.description: Maximum set size after intersection with tested genes.

decoupler_pb_ulm_on_de_statistic.description: Options for the default signed univariate linear model route.

tmin.description: Minimum targets per source for a fit; decoupler examples use 3.

signed.description: Use signed footprint weights; false uses unsigned set membership.

calibration.description: Donor-label permutation null used to calibrate p-values.

enabled.description: Permute donor labels within cell type to build an empirical null.

n_permutations.description: Donor-label permutations per cell type; exhaustive when fewer exist.

alpha.description: Nominal FDR level for significance, Benjamini-Hochberg within cell type.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for donor permutations and subsampling.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device only; no pathway tests are computed.

overwrite.description: Replace existing pathway_de members for the same method instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, one table per cell type plus the null and model state. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, cell_types_tested, n_tests, n_fdr_below_alpha, donors_per_group_min, null_min_pvalue (when calibration is enabled).

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device, and the number of tests and permutations.
